text_excerpt: Cancer vaccine and Immunotherapy treatments Innovative veterinary immunotherapy Innovative veterinary immunotherapy Innovative veterinary immunotherapy Innovative veterinary immunotherapy Learn More Our Mission To improve the lives of dogs, cats and horses with cancer by providing safe, personalized immunotherapy that harnesses each patient's own immune system to fight cancer and extend survival. About us D.O.G founder and lead research scientist, Dr Chris Weir, has been creating personalised vaccines for animals for over 16 years. The CANCV vaccine is the result of over a decade of testing and refinement to optimise the immune response to the cancer. CANCV is available through experienced oncologists and veterinarians.
